g.title: j2586885726
g.text: hey, um...

g.title: j2877619408
g.text: this might sound corny, but it’s important to me, so I’m just gonna say it.

g.title: j568934781
g.text: u make me feel like I belong

g.title: j1690573803
g.text: I don’t know if I can take credit for that. Someone as incredible as you always belongs with good people.

g.title: j1061430925
g.text: Me? But Aoi, everyone in the Hex absolutely adores you. Trust me.

g.title: j1532306513
g.text: The thought that you don't always feel that way honestly breaks my heart.

g.title: j3094496817
g.text: maybe... in a way

g.title: j167076287
g.text: oh, I know they do <3 and I adore them too but...

g.title: j2222955332
g.text: oh it's not like I've ever been excluded or anything!

g.title: j248288107
g.text: I mean, I know how to fit in anywhere, but that’s not the same as truly belonging.

g.title: j1338717599
g.text: I get that. Being appreciated is one thing. Feeling seen for who you really are is another.

g.title: j3341116925
g.text: No, I guess it’s not. Belonging is being seen for who you are and knowing that’s enough.

g.title: j915028477
g.text: Truly belonging is a tall order.

g.title: j1882087723
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2752771290
g.text: It sure is. And even so, you make me feel... hmm...

g.title: j1931305339
g.text: exactly. and that’s what you give me. even when things are chaotic or scary, with you, I feel… hmm…

g.title: j4150443050
g.text: at home

g.title: j3584614788
g.text: You’ve always felt like home to me too. Maybe I just didn’t know how to say it until now.

g.title: j318778277
g.text: You make me feel the same way. No matter what happens, I know I can count on you.

g.title: j3424171129
g.text: You’re a rare kind of friend, Aoi. One of the best. I’ll always make sure you feel seen.
